title: Self-Discovering Interpretable Diffusion Latent Directions for Responsible Text-to-Image Generation
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith, as it was not a focus of the research. The study's scope was limited to fairness in gender and race, and safety in terms of violent or sexual content.
